say:0:1422512001:0.female: Balkar is here! We hang out here all the time!

say:3:1422513003:1.source_cn: 你身后藏着什么，西蒙想看！

say:4:1422513004:1.source_cn: 哈哈，我在做你最喜欢的玩具，还没做好呢，长什么样子暂时保密！

say:5:1422513005:1.text: I'll wait for you to finish it then!
say:5:1422513005:1.source_cn: 那我等巴尔克做好再看！

say:6:1422513006:1.text: By the way, I ran into this gentleman who was looking for you, so I brought him here!
say:6:1422513006:1.source_cn: 对了，我遇到了这位来找你的<male>大哥哥</mal...
say:6:1422513006:1.male: By the way, I ran into this gentleman who was looking for you, so I brought him here!
say:6:1422513006:1.female: By the way, I ran into this lady who was looking for you, so I brought her here!

choice_prompt:7:1422513006.source_cn: 对了，我遇到了这位来找你的<male>大哥哥</male><female>大姐姐</female>，就带<male>他</male><female>她</female>来看你啦！

choice_prompt:7:1422513006.female: By the way, I ran into this lady who was looking for you, so I brought her here!

say:8:1422513007:1.text: I see... Indeed, I haven't been in touch with my friends in the village for quite some time...

say:8:1422513007:1.male: I see... Indeed, I haven't been in touch with my friends in the village for quite some time...
say:8:1422513007:1.female: I see... Indeed, I haven't been in touch with my friends in the village for quite some time...

say:9:1422513008:1.text: I should make a trip back soon. Thanks for coming all the way to find me!

say:9:1422513008:1.male: I should make a trip back soon. Thanks for coming all the way to find me!
say:9:1422513008:1.female: I should make a trip back soon. Thanks for coming all the way to find me!

say:10:1422513009:1.text: *Sob* Balkar, are you leaving soon? Does that mean I'll never see you again? You're my best friend...
say:10:1422513009:1.source_cn: 呜……巴尔克，你要回地表了吗？那样我就再也见不到你了！...

say:11:1422513010:1.text: I'll be so lonely without you! No one will be there to talk to me, play with me, or share cool things I don't know about...
say:11:1422513010:1.source_cn: 没有你我会很孤独的，不会有人陪我说话，陪我玩，也不会有...

say:12:1422513011:1.text: Oh, Siman! Please don't cry! I promise I'll be back soon! Seeing you cry breaks my heart...
say:12:1422513011:1.source_cn: 别哭！西蒙你不要哭呀！我只是回地表看看，很快就会回来的...

say:13:1422513012:1.text: Are you sure? How long will you be away? Will I ever see you again...
say:13:1422513012:1.source_cn: 你真的会回来吗？很快是有多快，我害怕再也见不到你……

choice_prompt:14:1422513012.text: Are you sure? How long will you be away? Will I ever see you again...
choice_prompt:14:1422513012.source_cn: 你真的会回来吗？很快是有多快，我害怕再也见不到你……

say:15:1422513013:0.text: Alright... Siman wants Balkar to be happy! Siman will wait!
say:15:1422513013:0.source_cn: 好吧，西蒙不想让巴尔克不开心，西蒙等着巴尔克，巴尔克一...

say:16:1422513014:0.source_cn: 那我就和特使大人先走了……放心，我们很快就会再见的！

choice:7:0:1.male: Your friend asked for my help.
choice:7:0:1.female: Your friend asked for my help.

say:1:1422514001:1.text: I'm worried about Siman. He looks so sad...

say:1:1422514001:1.female: I'm worried about Siman. He looks so sad...

say:2:1422514002:1.female: In fact, I'm almost done with my tasks in the royal city. Siman can probably feel that I'm about to leave, so he's been pretty anxious lately...

say:3:1422514003:1.source_cn: 我打算这次回去就跟负责人申请，继续在王城工作一段时间，...

choice_prompt:5:1422514004.source_cn: 没想到，还是让他担心了。

say:6:1422514005:1.female: I really want to... Alright, I've made up my mind—I'll finish making Siman's toy before I go!

choice_prompt:8:1422514006.source_cn: 他一直想亲眼见到那样的景象……我想，这件玩具他会喜欢的。

say:9:1422514007:1.female: I need some wood, along with some fuzzy mushrooms and skyflowers for the paint. Let's look for them together!

choice:8:1:2.text: What can I do to help?
choice:8:1:2.male: What can I do to help?
choice:8:1:2.female: What can I do to help?

choice:5:0:1.text: Will you cheer him up first?
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你想让他心情变好再回去？
choice:5:0:1.male: Will you cheer him up first?
choice:5:0:1.female: Will you cheer him up first?

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 你想让他彻底放心再回去？

say:1:1422515001:1.text: All the materials are ready! Let's get started!
say:1:1422515001:1.source_cn: 材料都齐了，到我干活的时候了！

say:1:1422515001:1.female: All the materials are ready! Let's get started!

narration:4:1422515002:0.text: After some hard work by Balkar, a small, palace-shaped wooden sculpture begins to take shape...
narration:4:1422515002:0.source_cn: 巴尔克一番忙活，一件宫殿形状的小木雕逐渐成型……

say:6:1422515003:1.source_cn: 做好了！完美实现了我的创意！

choice_prompt:8:1422515003.source_cn: 做好了！完美实现了我的创意！

say:9:1422515004:1.text: Siman longs to visit the royal city, so I want to show him the most beautiful spot there...
say:9:1422515004:1.source_cn: 西蒙的心里是很向往王城的，我一直想让他见到王城最美丽的...
say:9:1422515004:1.male: Siman longs to visit the royal city, so I want to show him the most beautiful spot there...
say:9:1422515004:1.female: Siman longs to visit the royal city, so I want to show him the most beautiful spot there...

say:10:1422515005:1.text: Since he can't visit there himself, this is how I can make his wish come true.
say:10:1422515005:1.source_cn: 如果他不能亲眼看见，我就用这种形式为他实现愿望吧！
say:10:1422515005:1.male: Since he can't visit there himself, this is how I can make his wish come true.
say:10:1422515005:1.female: Since he can't visit there himself, this is how I can make his wish come true.

say:0:1422518001:0.text: Let's give it to Siman; I'm sure he'll be surprised!
say:0:1422518001:0.source_cn: 我们回去找西蒙吧，他一定会很惊喜的！
say:0:1422518001:0.male: Let's give it to Siman; I'm sure he'll be surprised!
say:0:1422518001:0.female: Let's give it to Siman; I'm sure he'll be surprised!

say:1:1422519001:1.source_cn: 巴尔克，你这么快就回来啦！

say:2:1422519002:1.text: I want to give this to you before I go... Look, isn't this what you've always wanted?
say:2:1422519002:1.source_cn: 我想把这个交给你再离开……看，这是你一直想要的东西吗？

say:3:1422519003:1.text: A palace that fits in my hands? It's so beautiful...
say:3:1422519003:1.source_cn: 这是一座可以放在手上的宫殿？好美丽……

say:4:1422519004:1.text: It's called the Tenebris Court, the most exquisite building in the royal city. Your Queen resides there.
say:4:1422519004:1.source_cn: 它叫永夜圣庭，是艾塞勒王城最美丽的建筑，你们的女王就居...

say:5:1422519005:1.text: Balkar, thank you... I've always wondered what the royal city looks like. You really know me well!
say:5:1422519005:1.source_cn: 巴尔克，谢谢你……我一直想知道它的样子，好厉害，你是怎...

choice_prompt:6:1422519005.text: Balkar, thank you... I've always wondered what the royal city looks like. You really know me well!
choice_prompt:6:1422519005.source_cn: 巴尔克，谢谢你……我一直想知道它的样子，好厉害，你是怎么知道我的愿望的！

say:7:1422519006:1.text: Actually, I'm just curious about the world beyond the commoners' district...
say:7:1422519006:1.source_cn: 其实我只是想知道外面的世界长什么样子，想知道平民区外面...
say:7:1422519006:1.male: Actually, I'm just curious about the world beyond the commoners' district...
say:7:1422519006:1.female: Actually, I'm just curious about the world beyond the commoners' district...

say:8:1422519007:1.text: We all know we'll probably spend our entire lives here, but still, I really wish to see the scenery outside!
say:8:1422519007:1.source_cn: 平民区的小孩子都知道，大部分平民一辈子都要待在平民区，...
say:8:1422519007:1.male: We all know we'll probably spend our entire lives here, but still, I really wish to see the scenery outside!
say:8:1422519007:1.female: We all know we'll probably spend our entire lives here, but still, I really wish to see the scenery outside!

say:9:1422519008:1.text: I wish to visit the royal city, as well as Balkar's hometown!
say:9:1422519008:1.source_cn: 不仅有王城，还有巴尔克说的他的家乡！
say:9:1422519008:1.male: I wish to visit the royal city, as well as Balkar's hometown!
say:9:1422519008:1.female: I wish to visit the royal city, as well as Balkar's hometown!

say:10:1422519009:1.text: They all say the surface is a horrible place, but Balkar tells me otherwise...
say:10:1422519009:1.source_cn: 他们都说地表很可怕，但巴尔克却说地表是另一个美丽的世界……
say:10:1422519009:1.male: They all say the surface is a horrible place, but Balkar tells me otherwise...
say:10:1422519009:1.female: They all say the surface is a horrible place, but Balkar tells me otherwise...

say:11:1422519010:1.text: Balkar, thanks for showing me what I could only imagine before! I'm so happy!
say:11:1422519010:1.source_cn: 巴尔克，你又一次帮我看到了想象中的风景！我现在好开心！

say:12:1422519011:1.text: I'm glad you like it! Now, I can finally leave with my heart at ease.
say:12:1422519011:1.source_cn: 你开心就好！现在我终于能放心地回去了。

say:13:1422519012:1.text: I'll bring you some cool stuff from the surface when I get back!
say:13:1422519012:1.source_cn: 等我回来，我给你带地表好玩的东西！

say:14:1422519013:1.text: I can't wait! Go ahead, Balkar! Don't worry about me!
say:14:1422519013:1.source_cn: 我一定会喜欢的！巴尔克放心回家吧，别再担心我啦！

choice:6:0:1.text: Do you wish to move there?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 西蒙的愿望是在王城生活吗？
choice:6:0:1.male: Do you wish to move there?
choice:6:0:1.female: Do you wish to move there?

say:1:1422520001:1.text: I'll check in with my friends and boss at the village. Meanwhile, could you pick up some toys from the toy store?

say:3:1422520002:1.female: I'll leave it to you then!

say:2:1422521002:1.female: There are just too many items! I don't even know what I have in there myself!

say:0:1422521101:0.text: Here I am! Didn't take long, did I?
say:0:1422521101:0.source_cn: 我回来啦！动作很迅速吧！
say:0:1422521101:0.male: Here I am! Didn't take long, did I?
say:0:1422521101:0.female: Here I am! Didn't take long, did I?

say:1:1422522001:0.text: My boss has agreed to let me stay underground for a while longer!
say:1:1422522001:0.source_cn: 我跟同伴和负责人谈过啦，他们同意我在地底再待一段时间！
say:1:1422522001:0.male: My boss has agreed to let me stay underground for a while longer!
say:1:1422522001:0.female: My boss has agreed to let me stay underground for a while longer!

say:2:1422522002:1.text: Have you picked out anything? Great taste! Let me foot the bill.
say:2:1422522002:1.source_cn: 玩具也挑好了吗？真是不错的品味，我来付钱！
say:2:1422522002:1.male: Have you picked out anything? Great taste! Let me foot the bill.
say:2:1422522002:1.female: Have you picked out anything? Great taste! Let me foot the bill.

say:3:1422522003:1.text: Let's head back right away! We don't want to keep Siman waiting, do we?
say:3:1422522003:1.source_cn: 事情都办妥啦，我们走吧！回去还得好一会儿呢，西蒙该等得...
say:3:1422522003:1.male: Let's head back right away! We don't want to keep Siman waiting, do we?
say:3:1422522003:1.female: Let's head back right away! We don't want to keep Siman waiting, do we?

say:0:1422523001:0.text: Siman will be thrilled to see us!
say:0:1422523001:0.source_cn: 西蒙见到我们一定会很高兴的！
say:0:1422523001:0.male: Siman will be thrilled to see us!
say:0:1422523001:0.female: Siman will be thrilled to see us!

say:1:1422524001:1.text: Greetings! You must be Siman's mother. Is Siman at home?
say:1:1422524001:1.source_cn: 您好！是西蒙的母亲吧，请问西蒙在家吗？

say:2:1422524002:1.text: You're that wicked dwarf! Can't believe you have the nerve to show up here...
say:2:1422524002:1.source_cn: 你是那个矮人！你怎么还有脸来……都是你害了西蒙！

choice_prompt:3:1422524002.text: You're that wicked dwarf! Can't believe you have the nerve to show up here...
choice_prompt:3:1422524002.source_cn: 你是那个矮人！你怎么还有脸来……都是你害了西蒙！

say:4:1422524003:2.text: Siman, my poor son! He's gone... He's left me forever...
say:4:1422524003:2.source_cn: 西蒙，我可怜的孩子，他已经不在了，他永远离开了我……
say:4:1422524003:2.male: Siman, my poor son! He's gone... He's left me forever...
say:4:1422524003:2.female: Siman, my poor son! He's gone... He's left me forever...

say:5:1422524004:0.text: This can't be true! He was perfectly fine when I gave him my gift not long ago!
say:5:1422524004:0.source_cn: 可不久之前他还好好的！不久之前我还送了他礼物，当时他那...

say:6:1422524005:1.text: Gift... If you're talking about that palace-shaped sculpture, that's what got him in trouble!
say:6:1422524005:1.source_cn: 礼物……如果你说的是那件宫殿形状的小木雕，正是它害死了西蒙！

say:7:1422524006:1.text: Those guards on patrol saw Siman with that sculpture...
say:7:1422524006:1.source_cn: 目睹事情经过的人告诉我，那些巡逻的守卫看到了西蒙手上的...

say:8:1422524007:1.text: They shouted at Siman for disrespecting the Queen and tried to seize the sculpture from him...
say:8:1422524007:1.source_cn: 他们大叫着西蒙玷污了女王的居所，亵渎了女王的尊严，要把...

say:9:1422524008:1.text: But Siman just wouldn't let go... By the time I saw him, he had been brutally beaten, with blood trickling down his forehead!
say:9:1422524008:1.source_cn: 可西蒙是那么倔强……等我看到他的时候他已经经受了一顿毒...

say:10:1422524009:1.text: The priest refused to treat Siman. I tried everything I could, but neither the Divine Dew nor my prayers worked. In the end, he left me...
say:10:1422524009:1.source_cn: 我已经尽了所有的努力，可祭司不愿意医治孩子，恩典灵露和...

say:11:1422524010:1.text: I'm sorry... I just wanted to make his wish come true... I'm truly sorry...
say:11:1422524010:1.source_cn: 对不起……我只是想实现他的愿望……对不起……

say:12:1422524011:1.text: Siman... he was a unique child, full of eccentric ideas. Sometimes, even I found his ideas a bit unsettling...
say:12:1422524011:1.source_cn: 西蒙……他是个有点不一样的孩子，脑子里总是有那么多想法...

say:13:1422524012:1.text: It's my fault... I've neglected my duties as his mother. I should have reminded him about the things he shouldn't do—or even think about.
say:13:1422524012:1.source_cn: 是我没有照顾好他，没有告诉他，很多事是不能做，甚至不能...

say:14:1422524013:1.text: This... is what's left of that sculpture. Siman held it tightly in his hands during his final moments.
say:14:1422524013:1.source_cn: 那件木雕……只剩这一块了，西蒙在走之前把它紧紧攥在手心里面。

say:15:1422524014:1.text: You can have it if you want. At least, it gave Siman some peace before he passed.
say:15:1422524014:1.source_cn: 如果你愿意的话，把这东西拿去吧，至少……它在西蒙走之前...

say:16:1422524015:1.text: I have nothing more to say to you. Please, just leave.
say:16:1422524015:1.source_cn: 该说的话说完了，请你们……离开吧。

say:1:1422525001:1.text: Sir, I think... there's no reason for me to stay in Sal'thorin anymore.
say:1:1422525001:1.source_cn: 特使大人，我想……我没有继续留在萨洛克兰的理由了。
say:1:1422525001:1.male: Sir, I think... there's no reason for me to stay in Sal'thorin anymore.
say:1:1422525001:1.female: Madam, I think... there's no reason for me to stay in Sal'thorin anymore.

choice_prompt:2:1422525001.text: Sir, I think... there's no reason for me to stay in Sal'thorin anymore.
choice_prompt:2:1422525001.source_cn: 特使大人，我想……我没有继续留在萨洛克兰的理由了。
choice_prompt:2:1422525001.male: Sir, I think... there's no reason for me to stay in Sal'thorin anymore.
choice_prompt:2:1422525001.female: Madam, I think... there's no reason for me to stay in Sal'thorin anymore.

say:3:1422525002:1.text: Yes, I want to leave this place where inhumanity reigns. Before I go, there's something I need to do.
say:3:1422525002:1.source_cn: 是的，我想离开这个残酷的地方。但在离开之前，我还有事想做。
say:3:1422525002:1.male: Yes, I want to leave this place where inhumanity reigns. Before I go, there's something I need to do.
say:3:1422525002:1.female: Yes, I want to leave this place where inhumanity reigns. Before I go, there's something I need to do.

say:4:1422525003:1.text: Siman was so excited about the toy we got him from the surface... I should leave it here for him.
say:4:1422525003:1.source_cn: 西蒙很期待我们在地表买的玩具……我想把它留在萨洛克兰。
say:4:1422525003:1.male: Siman was so excited about the toy we got him from the surface... I should leave it here for him.
say:4:1422525003:1.female: Siman was so excited about the toy we got him from the surface... I should leave it here for him.

choice_prompt:5:1422525003.male: Siman was so excited about the toy we got him from the surface... I should leave it here for him.
choice_prompt:5:1422525003.female: Siman was so excited about the toy we got him from the surface... I should leave it here for him.

say:1:1422527001:1.text: That's the last thing I want to do before I leave...
say:1:1422527001:1.male: That's the last thing I want to do before I leave...
say:1:1422527001:1.female: That's the last thing I want to do before I leave...

choice_prompt:2:1422527001.text: That's the last thing I want to do before I leave...
choice_prompt:2:1422527001.male: That's the last thing I want to do before I leave...
choice_prompt:2:1422527001.female: That's the last thing I want to do before I leave...

say:3:1422527002:1.text: I'm keeping it as a reminder of everything that took place here...
say:3:1422527002:1.source_cn: 我想留着它，提醒我不要忘记这一切……
say:3:1422527002:1.male: I'm keeping it as a reminder of everything that took place here...
say:3:1422527002:1.female: I'm keeping it as a reminder of everything that took place here...

say:4:1422527003:1.text: Now, it's time for me to bid farewell to Sal'thorin!
say:4:1422527003:1.source_cn: 好了，是时候跟萨洛克兰告别了！
say:4:1422527003:1.male: Now, it's time for me to bid farewell to Sal'thorin!
say:4:1422527003:1.female: Now, it's time for me to bid farewell to Sal'thorin!

choice_prompt:5:1422527003.male: Now, it's time for me to bid farewell to Sal'thorin!
choice_prompt:5:1422527003.female: Now, it's time for me to bid farewell to Sal'thorin!

say:6:1422527004:1.text: I don't have any concrete plans yet... Maybe a toy maker? I love bringing joy to children...
say:6:1422527004:1.source_cn: 我没想好……或许，做一个玩具师会不错？能给更多的孩子带...
say:6:1422527004:1.male: I don't have any concrete plans yet... Maybe a toy maker? I love bringing joy to children...
say:6:1422527004:1.female: I don't have any concrete plans yet... Maybe a toy maker? I love bringing joy to children...

say:7:1422527005:1.text: Siman would be thrilled if he could hear this.
say:7:1422527005:1.source_cn: 如果西蒙知道了，应该会很开心吧。
say:7:1422527005:1.male: Siman would be thrilled if he could hear this.
say:7:1422527005:1.female: Siman would be thrilled if he could hear this.

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 那块木雕碎片……不一起埋葬吗？
